rachel (arch): quick sync - we had alias flip turbulence in staging; proposal: add lightweight rollout metadata to avoid immediate hard-evicts on alias writes.
tom (runtime): current problem: publish alias -> runtime unbinds cached variant immediately -> cold starts.
ishaan (infra): curious if this is resolver churn or control-plane write storms?
tom (runtime): mainly control-plane. small doc sketch: fields: stability_window_ms, evict_grace_ms, alias_mode (hard|soft|sticky), expected_dual_serve. default is hard for backward compat.
megan (product): customers saw errors during canary. we'd like staged rollouts with minimal impact. UI should show expected_dual_serve flag.
rachel (arch): tenant pins should always override metadata; add tenant_eviction_opt_out for enterprise.
ishaan (infra): older runtimes must ignore unknown fields. gate soft-mode behind a feature-flag per-cluster.
tom (runtime): runtime plan: lease states ACTIVE, PENDING_DEFERRED_EVICT, STALE. on flip mark previous pending and background-reconcile after evict_grace_ms + low traffic. tests: simulate alias flip storm and assert cold-starts stay within baseline factor.
pager-bot: created TKT-2026-998: "alias soft-evict metrics + alerts" assigned to tom.
rachel (arch): decision: prototype soft alias_mode in staging behind FF. owners: tom(runtime), ishaan(infra), megan(product). follow-up: formal RFC with schema and telemetry requirements.
